days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Besucherzentrum
stops.detail: The main entrance with the visitor centre is located near the village of Otterlo (municipality of Ede).

stops.name: Museonder
stops.detail: Located beneath the visitor centre is the Museonder, a museum for underground life that is also interesting for children.

stops.name: Kröller-Müller Museum
stops.detail: Helene Kröller-Müller's significant art collection is housed in the Kröller-Müller Museum, which is located in the northern part of the park.

stops.name: Sandmagerrasen
stops.detail: In the north of the nature park, there are also large sandy grasslands.
